Flagging this before I release today's manifest, as it is time-critical and irreversible.

- Contact notes record that none of the letters or photos were ever copied; these are the only ones.

But if permission is not registered before I release (13:30), the only copies of this family's correspondence and photographs will be destroyed before the request is even reviewed.

Please advise / register permission before 13:30 if you want this box held. I will keep working the rest of the queue meanwhile.
